install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("patchwork")

```{r}

BASE <- "C:/Users/30697/Desktop/Διπλωματική"

# FRANCE 
#asthma

#first plot male+prevalence
asthma_male_pr <- read.csv(paste0(BASE, "/France/asthma-male-prevalence.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(asthma_male_pr)


library(dplyr)
# check the form of age_name
unique(asthma_male_pr$age_name)


asthma_male_pr <- asthma_male_pr %>%
  mutate(age_group = case_when(
    age %in% c("20-24 years", "25-29 years") ~ "20s",
    age %in% c("30-34 years", "35-39 years") ~ "30s",
    age %in% c("40-44 years", "45-49 years") ~ "40s",
    age %in% c("50-54 years", "55-59 years") ~ "50s",
    age %in% c("60-64 years", "65-69 years") ~ "60s",
    age == "70+ years" ~ "70+"
  ))

# Grouping and calculating the mean by year and by the new age group
asthma_male_pr_summary <- asthma_male_pr %>%
  group_by(year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)

# plots
ggplot_asthma_male_pr <- ggplot(asthma_male_pr_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = val, group = age_group, color = age_group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate per 100,000 population",
    title = "Asthma Male Prevalence",
    color = "Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(asthma_male_pr_summary$year), max(asthma_male_pr_summary$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
ggplot_asthma_male_pr


#second plot male+incidence
asthma_male_inc <- read.csv(paste0(BASE, "/France/asthma-male-incidence.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(asthma_male_inc)

  ))

asthma_male_inc_summary <- asthma_male_inc %>%
  group_by(year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot_asthma_male_inc <- ggplot(asthma_male_inc_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = val, group = age_group, color = age_group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate per 100,000 population",
    title = "Asthma Male Incidence",
    color = "Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(asthma_male_inc_summary$year), max(asthma_male_inc_summary$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
ggplot_asthma_male_inc

#all the asthma plots together

library(patchwork)

ggplot_asthma_male_inc <- ggplot_asthma_male_inc +
  labs(y = rate_label) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggplot_asthma_male_pr <- ggplot_asthma_male_pr +
  labs(y = NULL) +

    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),

ggplot_asthma_female_inc <- ggplot_asthma_female_inc +

ggplot_asthma_female_pr <- ggplot_asthma_female_pr +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  theme(

    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

combined_plot <- (ggplot_asthma_male_inc + ggplot_asthma_male_pr +
                    ggplot_asthma_female_inc + ggplot_asthma_female_pr) +
  plot_layout(nrow = 2, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined_plot + plot_annotation(
  title = "France",
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5))
)
```

```{r}
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
  ))

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(

    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
```
```{r}
    breaks = seq(min(asthma_male_inc_summary$year), max(asthma_male_inc_summary$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
```

```{r}
#atopic dermatitis - Norway

atopic.derm_male_pr <- read.csv(paste0(BASE, "/Norway/atopic dermatitis-male-pr.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(atopic.derm_male_pr)
library(dplyr)

unique(atopic.derm_male_pr$age)

atopic.derm_male_pr <- atopic.derm_male_pr %>%
  mutate(age_group = case_when(
    age %in% c("20-24 years", "25-29 years") ~ "20s",
    age %in% c("30-34 years", "35-39 years") ~ "30s",
    age %in% c("40-44 years", "45-49 years") ~ "40s",
    age %in% c("50-54 years", "55-59 years") ~ "50s",
    age %in% c("60-64 years", "65-69 years") ~ "60s",
    age == "70+ years" ~ "70+"
  ))

atopic.derm_male_pr_summary <- atopic.derm_male_pr %>%
  group_by(year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot_atopic.derm_male_pr <- ggplot(atopic.derm_male_pr_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = val, group = age_group, color = age_group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate per 100,000 population",
    title = "Atopic.derm Male Prevalence",
    color = "Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(atopic.derm_male_pr_summary$year), max(atopic.derm_male_pr_summary$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)

    age %in% c("30-34 years", "35-39 years") ~ "30s",
    age %in% c("40-44 years", "45-49 years") ~ "40s",
    age %in% c("50-54 years", "55-59 years") ~ "50s",
    age %in% c("60-64 years", "65-69 years") ~ "60s",
    age == "70+ years" ~ "70+"
  ))
```

```{r}
  group_by(year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot_rheum.arthr_female_pr <- ggplot(rheum.arthr_female_pr_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = val, group = age_group, color = age_group)) +

  geom_point(size = 2) +

    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate per 100,000 population",
    title = "Rheum.arthr Female Prevalence",
    color = "Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(rheum.arthr_female_pr_summary$year), max(rheum.arthr_female_pr_summary$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
```

```{r}
unique(atopic.derm_female_pr$age)

atopic.derm_female_pr <- atopic.derm_female_pr %>%
  mutate(age_group = case_when(
    age %in% c("20-24 years", "25-29 years") ~ "20s",
    age %in% c("30-34 years", "35-39 years") ~ "30s",
    age %in% c("40-44 years", "45-49 years") ~ "40s",
    age %in% c("50-54 years", "55-59 years") ~ "50s",
    age %in% c("60-64 years", "65-69 years") ~ "60s",
    age == "70+ years" ~ "70+"
  ))

atopic.derm_female_pr_summary <- atopic.derm_female_pr %>%
  group_by(year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)
ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr <- ggplot(atopic.derm_female_pr_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = val, group = age_group, color = age_group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate per 100,000 population",
    title = "Atopic.derm Female Prevalence",
    color = "Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(atopic.derm_female_pr_summary$year), max(atopic.derm_female_pr_summary$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr

#plot without ages
atopic.derm_female_pr_summary2 <- atopic.derm_female_pr_summary %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val), .groups = "drop")

ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr_summary2 <- ggplot(atopic.derm_female_pr_summary2, aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = val)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate",
    title = "atopic.derm_female_prevalence "
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(atopic.derm_female_pr_summary2$year), max(atopic.derm_female_pr_summary2$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr_summary2


#all the atopic plots together

library(patchwork)

rate_label <- "Rate per 100,000\npopulation"

ggplot_atopic.derm_male_inc <- ggplot_atopic.derm_male_inc +
  labs(y = rate_label) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggplot_atopic.derm_male_pr <- ggplot_atopic.derm_male_pr +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggplot_atopic.derm_female_inc <- ggplot_atopic.derm_female_inc +
  labs(y = rate_label) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr <- ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

combined_plot <- (ggplot_atopic.derm_male_inc + ggplot_atopic.derm_male_pr +
                    ggplot_atopic.derm_female_inc + ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr) +
  plot_layout(nrow = 2, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined_plot + plot_annotation(
  title = "Portugal",
  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5))
)



#all the atopic derm plots together without ages

                     ggplot_atopic.derm_female_inc_summary2 + ggplot_atopic.derm_female_pr_summary2) +

)
```

```{r}
)

  )

  plot_layout(nrow = 2, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
  title = "Sweden",

)
```

```{r}
IBD_female_inc <- IBD_female_inc %>%
  mutate(age_group = case_when(
    age %in% c("20-24 years", "25-29 years") ~ "20s",
    age %in% c("30-34 years", "35-39 years") ~ "30s",
    age %in% c("40-44 years", "45-49 years") ~ "40s",
    age %in% c("50-54 years", "55-59 years") ~ "50s",
    age %in% c("60-64 years", "65-69 years") ~ "60s",
    age == "70+ years" ~ "70+"
  ))

IBD_female_inc_summary <- IBD_female_inc %>%
  group_by(year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val), .groups = "drop")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot_IBD_female_inc <- ggplot(IBD_female_inc_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(year), y = val, group = age_group, color = age_group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Rate per 100,000 population",
    title = "IBD Female Incidence",
    color = "Age Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(IBD_female_inc_summary$year), max(IBD_female_inc_summary$year), by = 5),
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0)
ggplot_IBD_female_inc
```

```{r}
library(broom)
full_data_res <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence") %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, age) %>%
  do({
    model <- lm(val ~ year, data = .)
    data.frame(
      year = as.numeric(.$year),  # convert year to numeric
      val = .$val,
      fitted = fitted(model),
      residuals = resid(model),
      location = .$location,
      cause = .$cause,
      sex = .$sex,
      age = .$age
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(location, cause, sex, age, year)  # sort by year for proper lines


```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)   
# trend data by sex, country, disease and year
df_trend <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence") %>%
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, year) %>%
  summarise(
    val   = mean(val,   na.rm = TRUE),
    lower = mean(lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper = mean(upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# x-axis by decade 
yr_min <- floor(min(df_trend$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
yr_max <- ceiling(max(df_trend$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
x_breaks_10 <- seq(yr_min, yr_max, by = 10)

# Function to plot trends by country
make_trend_by_sex <- function(d, country) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = val)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = sex),
                alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
    geom_point(aes(color = sex), alpha = 0.85, size = 1.6) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = sex), method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks_10, limits = c(yr_min, yr_max)) +
    labs(title = paste("Prevalence Trends —", country),
         x = "Year", y = "Prevalence",
         color = "Sex", fill = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# Loop through all countries
for (cty in sort(unique(df_trend$location))) {
  p_trend <- make_trend_by_sex(filter(df_trend, location == cty), cty)
  print(p_trend)
}

```

```{r}

diag_df_all <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence") %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, age) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    m <- lm(val ~ year, data = .x)
    augment(m, data = .x)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# Functions for the 3 diagnostics (by country)

# (a) Residuals vs Fitted  —  by cause, colour=sex
make_resid_vs_fitted <- function(d, country) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .fitted, y = .std.resid, color = sex)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, span = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = paste("Residuals vs Fitted —", country, "(standardized)"),
         x = "Fitted values", y = "Standardized residuals", color = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# (b) Scale–Location  —  Test for homoscedasticity
make_scale_location <- function(d, country) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .fitted, y = sqrt(abs(.std.resid)), color = sex)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6, span = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = paste("Scale–Location —", country),
         x = "Fitted values", y = "sqrt(|standardized residuals|)", color = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# (c) QQ-plot  —  Checking the normality of the residuals
make_qq <- function(d, country) {
  ggplot(d, aes(sample = .std.resid, color = sex)) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_qq_line(aes(group = cause), color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ cause) +
    labs(title = paste("QQ-Plot Standardized Residuals —", country),
         x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Standardized Residuals", color = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# Loop through all countries

for (cty in sort(unique(diag_df_all$location))) {
  d_cty <- diag_df_all %>% filter(location == cty)

  p1 <- make_resid_vs_fitted(d_cty, cty)
  p2 <- make_scale_location(d_cty, cty)
  p3 <- make_qq(d_cty, cty)

  print(p1)
  print(p2)
  print(p3)
}
```

```{r}
full_data <- full_data %>%

  )

# x-axis by decade
yr_min      <- floor(min(full_data$year, na.rm = TRUE)/10)*10
yr_max      <- ceiling(max(full_data$year, na.rm = TRUE)/10)*10
x_breaks_10 <- seq(yr_min, yr_max, by = 10)

# TRENDS by country, cause, sex, age and year
df_trend_age <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence") %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, age, year) %>%
  summarise(
    val   = mean(val,   na.rm = TRUE),
    lower = mean(lower, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

diag_df_all <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence") %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, age) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    m <- lm(val ~ year, data = .x)
    augment(m, data = .x) 
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    age = factor(age, levels = age_levels),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female","Male"))
  )

# Trends plot: by cause and ages
make_trend_sex_age <- function(d, country, sex_name) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = year, y = val, color = age)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, group = age),
                alpha = 0.10, fill = "grey70", colour = NA) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.60, size = 1.2) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = age_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks_10, limits = c(yr_min, yr_max)) +
    labs(title = paste("Prevalence Trends —", country, "—", sex_name),
         x = "Year", y = "Prevalence", color = "Age group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

# 2) Residuals vs Fitted by cause by ages
make_resid_vs_fitted_sex_age_pretty <- function(d, country, sex_name) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .fitted, y = .std.resid, color = age)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.60, size = 1.1) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = cause), method = "loess", se = FALSE,
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, span = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = age_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_x") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
    labs(title = paste("Residuals vs Fitted —", country, "—", sex_name, "(standardized)"),
         x = "Fitted values", y = "Standardized residuals",
         color = "Age group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

# 3) Scale–Location by cause by ages
make_scale_location_sex_age_pretty <- function(d, country, sex_name) {
  ggplot(d, aes(x = .fitted, y = sqrt(abs(.std.resid)), color = age)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.60, size = 1.1) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = cause), method = "loess", se = FALSE,
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, span = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = age_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = paste("Scale–Location —", country, "—", sex_name),
         x = "Fitted values", y = "sqrt(|standardized residuals|)",
         color = "Age group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

# 4) QQ-plot: by cause by ages
make_qq_sex_age_pretty <- function(d, country, sex_name) {
  ggplot(d, aes(sample = .std.resid, color = age)) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.65, size = 1.4) +
    stat_qq_line(aes(group = cause), color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = age_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
    labs(title = paste("QQ-Plot Standardized Residuals —", country, "—", sex_name),
         x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Standardized Residuals",
         color = "Age group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

# Loops through all countries
countries <- sort(unique(full_data$location))

for (cty in countries) {
  for (sx in c("Female","Male")) {
    #TRENDS
    p_trend <- make_trend_sex_age(

    #QQ-plot

    )

  }
}
```

```{r}
#prepare data for gam model
causes_gam <- c("Asthma", "Inflammatory bowel disease")

dat_gam <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence", cause %in% causes_gam) %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female","Male")),
    age = factor(age, levels = c("20s","30s","40s","50s","60s","70+"))
  )

yr_min <- floor(min(dat_gam$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
yr_max <- ceiling(max(dat_gam$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
x_breaks_10 <- seq(yr_min, yr_max, by = 10)

age_cols <- c("20s"="#1b9e77","30s"="#d95f02","40s"="#7570b3",
              "50s"="#e7298a","60s"="#66a61e","70+"="#e6ab02")


fit_one_gam <- function(df, k = 6) {
  m <- gam(val ~ s(year, k = k), data = df, method = "REML")
  summ <- summary(m)
  
  df_aug <- df %>%
  mutate(
    .fitted = as.numeric(fitted(m)),
    .resid  = as.numeric(residuals(m, type = "deviance")),
    .stdres = .resid / sd(.resid, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, val, .fitted, .resid, .stdres) 
  
  
  newd <- df %>% distinct(year) %>% arrange(year)
  pr   <- predict(m, newdata = newd, se.fit = TRUE)
  crit <- qnorm(0.975)
  pred <- newd %>%
    mutate(
      fit = as.numeric(pr$fit),
      lwr = fit - crit * pr$se.fit,
      upr = fit + crit * pr$se.fit
    )
  
  list(model = m,
       aug   = df_aug,
       pred  = pred,
       aic   = AIC(m),
       edf   = summ$edf,          
       r2_gam = summ$r.sq)         
}

gam_fits <- dat_gam %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, age) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map(~ {
    out <- fit_one_gam(.x, k = 6)
    tibble(
      location = .x$location[1],
      cause    = .x$cause[1],
      sex      = .x$sex[1],
      age      = .x$age[1],
      aic      = out$aic,
      r2_gam   = out$r2_gam,
      model    = list(out$model),
      aug      = list(out$aug),
      pred     = list(out$pred)
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

gam_aug  <- gam_fits %>% select(location,cause,sex,age,aug)  %>% unnest(aug)
gam_pred <- gam_fits %>% select(location,cause,sex,age,pred) %>% unnest(pred)


#trends - ages
make_gam_trend_country_sex <- function(cty, sx) {
  d_points <- dat_gam %>% filter(location == cty, sex == sx)
  d_pred   <- gam_pred %>% filter(location == cty, sex == sx)
  
  ggplot() +
    # CI by age
    geom_ribbon(data = d_pred,
                aes(x = year, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = age),
                alpha = 0.12, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(data = d_pred,
              aes(x = year, y = fit, color = age),
              linewidth = 1.0) +

    geom_point(data = d_points,
               aes(x = year, y = val, color = age),
               alpha = 0.45, size = 1.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks_10, limits = c(yr_min, yr_max)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = age_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = age_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste("GAM Trends —", cty, "—", sx),
         x = "Year", y = "Prevalence", color = "Age group") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

# print for all the countries 
for (cty in sort(unique(dat_gam$location))) {
  for (sx in c("Female","Male")) {
    print(make_gam_trend_country_sex(cty, sx))
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(mgcv)

# Create LM and GAM models for each combination 
model_compare <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence") %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, age) %>%
  nest() %>%
  mutate(
    lm_model = map(data, ~ lm(val ~ year, data = .x)),
    gam_model = map(data, ~ gam(val ~ s(year, k = 10), data = .x, method = "REML"))
  )


compare_stats <- model_compare %>%
  mutate(
    lm_r2 = map_dbl(lm_model, ~ summary(.x)$r.squared),
    gam_r2 = map_dbl(gam_model, ~ summary(.x)$r.sq),
    lm_adj_r2 = map_dbl(lm_model, ~ summary(.x)$adj.r.squared),
    gam_dev = map_dbl(gam_model, ~ summary(.x)$dev.expl * 100),
    gam_edf = map_dbl(gam_model, ~ summary(.x)$s.table[1, "edf"]),
    lm_aic = map_dbl(lm_model, AIC),
    gam_aic = map_dbl(gam_model, AIC)
  ) %>%
  select(location, cause, sex, age,
         lm_r2, lm_adj_r2, lm_aic,
         gam_r2, gam_dev, gam_edf, gam_aic)


compare_summary <- compare_stats %>%
  mutate(
    better_model = case_when(
      gam_r2 > lm_r2 & gam_aic < lm_aic ~ "GAM better",
      TRUE ~ "LM better"
    )
  )


compare_summary %>%
  filter(cause %in% c("Asthma", "Inflammatory bowel disease")) %>%
  arrange(location, sex, age)
```

```{r}


# choose the right data
df_sex_year <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence",
         cause %in% c("Asthma", "Inflammatory bowel disease")) %>%
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female","Male"))) %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, year) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

yr_min <- floor(min(df_sex_year$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
yr_max <- ceiling(max(df_sex_year$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
x_breaks_10 <- seq(yr_min, yr_max, by = 10)

# Fitting GAM by country, sex and cause
safe_k <- function(n_years) max(3, min(8, n_years - 1))

fit_gam_by_panel <- function(df) {
  ky <- safe_k(length(unique(df$year)))
  m  <- gam(val ~ s(year, k = ky), data = df, family = gaussian(), method = "REML")

  newd <- df %>% distinct(year) %>% arrange(year)
  pr  <- predict(m, newdata = newd, se.fit = TRUE)
  crit <- qnorm(0.975)

  pred <- newd %>%
    mutate(
      fit  = as.numeric(pr$fit),
      se   = as.numeric(pr$se.fit),
      lwr  = fit - crit * se,
      upr  = fit + crit * se
    )

  res_raw <- residuals(m, type = "pearson")
  res_sd  <- sd(res_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  res_std <- as.numeric(res_raw / ifelse(res_sd == 0, 1, res_sd))

  diag <- df %>%
    mutate(
      .fitted     = fitted(m),
      .resid      = res_raw,
      .std.resid  = res_std
    )

  list(model = m, pred = pred, diag = diag)
}

gam_out <- df_sex_year %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex) %>%
  arrange(year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    out <- fit_gam_by_panel(.x)
    tibble(
      pred_list = list(out$pred),
      diag_list = list(out$diag)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

gam_pred <- gam_out %>% select(location, cause, sex, pred_list) %>% unnest(pred_list)
gam_diag <- gam_out %>% select(location, cause, sex, diag_list) %>% unnest(diag_list)

# Plot functions
plot_gam_trends_by_sex <- function(cty) {
  d_obs <- df_sex_year %>% filter(location == cty)
  d_fit <- gam_pred    %>% filter(location == cty)
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = d_obs, aes(year, val, color = sex), alpha = 0.55, size = 1.3) +
    geom_ribbon(data = d_fit, aes(x = year, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = sex),
                alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(data = d_fit, aes(year, fit, color = sex), linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks_10, limits = c(yr_min, yr_max)) +
    labs(title = paste("GAM Prevalence Trends —", cty),
         x = "Year", y = "Prevalence", color = "Sex", fill = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

plot_gam_resid_fitted_by_sex <- function(cty) {
  d <- gam_diag %>% filter(location == cty)
  ggplot(d, aes(.fitted, .std.resid, color = sex)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, span = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = paste("Residuals vs Fitted (GAM) —", cty),
         x = "Fitted values", y = "Standardized residuals", color = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

plot_gam_scale_location_by_sex <- function(cty) {
  d <- gam_diag %>% filter(location == cty) %>%
    mutate(sqrt_std = sqrt(abs(.std.resid)))
  ggplot(d, aes(.fitted, sqrt_std, color = sex)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.1) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.7, span = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(title = paste("Scale–Location (GAM) —", cty),
         x = "Fitted values", y = "sqrt(|standardized residuals|)", color = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

plot_gam_qq_by_sex <- function(cty) {
  d <- gam_diag %>% filter(location == cty)
  ggplot(d, aes(sample = .std.resid, color = sex)) +
    stat_qq(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
    stat_qq_line(aes(group = cause), color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ cause) +
    labs(title = paste("QQ-Plot Standardized Residuals (GAM) —", cty),
         x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Standardized Residuals", color = "Sex") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

for (cty in sort(unique(df_sex_year$location))) {
  print(plot_gam_trends_by_sex(cty))
  print(plot_gam_resid_fitted_by_sex(cty))
  print(plot_gam_scale_location_by_sex(cty))
  print(plot_gam_qq_by_sex(cty))
}
```

```{r}
#plot for linear+gam models

df_obs <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence",
         cause %in% c("Asthma","Inflammatory bowel disease")) %>%
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female","Male"))) %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex, year) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

yr_min <- floor(min(df_obs$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
yr_max <- ceiling(max(df_obs$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
x_breaks_10 <- seq(yr_min, yr_max, by = 10)


safe_k <- function(n_years) max(3, min(8, n_years - 1))

fit_two_models <- function(df_panel) {
  yrs  <- sort(unique(df_panel$year))
  grid <- data.frame(year = seq(min(yrs), max(yrs), by = 1))

  # LM
  m_lm <- lm(val ~ year, data = df_panel)
  pred_lm <- grid %>%
    mutate(fit = as.numeric(predict(m_lm, newdata = grid)),
           lwr = NA_real_, upr = NA_real_, model = "LM")

  # GAM
  k_use <- safe_k(length(yrs))
  m_gam <- mgcv::gam(val ~ s(year, k = k_use), data = df_panel, method = "REML")
  pr <- predict(m_gam, newdata = grid, se.fit = TRUE)
  crit <- qnorm(0.975)
  pred_gam <- grid %>%
    mutate(fit = as.numeric(pr$fit),
           lwr = fit - crit * as.numeric(pr$se.fit),
           upr = fit + crit * as.numeric(pr$se.fit),
           model = "GAM")

  bind_rows(pred_lm, pred_gam)
}

make_compare_country <- function(country_name) {

  obs_cty <- df_obs %>% filter(location == country_name)

  preds_cty <- obs_cty %>%
    group_by(cause, sex) %>%
    group_modify(~ fit_two_models(.x)) %>%
    ungroup()

  ggplot() +
  
    geom_point(data = obs_cty,
               aes(x = year, y = val, color = sex),
               alpha = 0.55, size = 1.0) +
    
    geom_ribbon(data = preds_cty %>% filter(model == "GAM"),
                aes(x = year, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = sex),
                alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    
    geom_line(data = preds_cty,
              aes(x = year, y = fit, color = sex, linetype = model),
              linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ cause, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(GAM = "solid", LM = "dashed")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks_10, limits = c(yr_min, yr_max)) +
    labs(title = paste("Observed vs LM vs GAM —", country_name),
         x = "Year", y = "Prevalence",
         color = "Sex", fill = "Sex", linetype = "Model") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}


countries <- df_obs %>% distinct(location) %>% pull(location) %>% sort()

for (cty in countries) {
  p_cty <- make_compare_country(cty)
  print(p_cty)
}
```

```{r}
# Tables to identify statistically significant results

library(mgcv)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)

# Data for Asthma & IBD
df_trend <- df_obs %>%
  filter(cause %in% c("Asthma", "Inflammatory bowel disease"))


fit_models_summary <- function(df) {
  lm_fit <- lm(val ~ year, data = df)
  gam_fit <- gam(val ~ s(year, k = 6), data = df, method = "REML")

  # LM
  lm_sum <- tidy(lm_fit) %>%
    filter(term == "year") %>%
    transmute(
      Model = "LM",
      Slope = estimate,
      p_value = p.value,
      Significant = p.value < 0.05,
      Trend = ifelse(estimate > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing")
    )

  # GAM
  gam_tab <- as.data.frame(summary(gam_fit)$s.table)
  p_val_gam <- if ("p-value" %in% names(gam_tab)) gam_tab[1, "p-value"] else gam_tab[1, "p.value"]

  gam_sum <- tibble(
    Model = "GAM",
    Slope = NA_real_,
    p_value = p_val_gam,
    Significant = p_val_gam < 0.05,
    Trend = NA_character_
  )

  bind_rows(lm_sum, gam_sum)
}

trend_table <- df_trend %>%
  group_by(location, cause, sex) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_models_summary(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Slope = round(Slope, 4),
    p_value = signif(p_value, 3),
    Significant = ifelse(Significant, "✅ Yes", "❌ No")
  )

knitr::kable(
  trend_table,
  caption = "Trend Significance (LM vs GAM) for Asthma and IBD by Country and Sex"
)
```

```{r}
model_compare_focus <- df_focus %>%

compare_focus <- model_compare_focus %>%
  mutate(

# R² plot
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)


year_start <- 1990
year_end   <- 2021

measures_keep <- c("Prevalence")  

age_levels <- c("20s","30s","40s","50s","60s","70+")
sex_levels <- c("Female","Male")


df_arrows <- full_data %>%
  filter(
    measure %in% measures_keep,
    year %in% c(year_start, year_end),
    age %in% age_levels,
    sex %in% sex_levels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    age  = factor(age, levels = age_levels),
    sex  = factor(sex, levels = sex_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(measure, location, cause, sex, age, year) %>%
  summarise(
    lower = mean(lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper = mean(upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = year,
    values_from = c(lower, upper),
    names_sep   = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower_start = .data[[paste0("lower_", year_start)]],
    upper_start = .data[[paste0("upper_", year_start)]],
    lower_end   = .data[[paste0("lower_", year_end)]],
    upper_end   = .data[[paste0("upper_", year_end)]],

    arrow = case_when(
      is.na(lower_start) | is.na(upper_start) | is.na(lower_end) | is.na(upper_end) ~ NA_character_,
      lower_end > upper_start ~ "↑",
      upper_end < lower_start ~ "↓",
      TRUE ~ "—"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(measure, cause, location, sex, age, arrow)


tables_by_disease <- df_arrows %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = sex_levels),
    age = factor(age, levels = age_levels)
  ) %>%
  split(.$cause) %>%
  lapply(function(d) {

    tab <- d %>%
      select(location, sex, age, arrow) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = age, values_from = arrow)

    # fill missing age columns (if any)
    missing_ages <- setdiff(age_levels, names(tab))
    if (length(missing_ages) > 0) tab[missing_ages] <- NA_character_

    tab %>%
      select(location, sex, all_of(age_levels)) %>%
      arrange(location, sex)
  })
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

percent_cutoff <- 0.03
year_start <- 1990
year_end   <- 2021
years_span <- year_end - year_start

df_prev <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence", metric == "Rate") %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))


df_age_mean <- df_prev %>%
  group_by(cause, location, sex, year) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


df_country_series <- df_age_mean %>%
  group_by(cause, location, year) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


level_tbl <- df_country_series %>%
  group_by(cause, location) %>%
  summarise(level = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


slopes_country <- df_country_series %>%
  group_by(cause, location) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(val ~ year, data = .)) %>% filter(term == "year")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(cause, location, slope = estimate) %>%
  left_join(level_tbl, by = c("cause","location")) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_1990_2021 = slope * years_span,
    rel_change = delta_1990_2021 / level,     
    sign = case_when(
      is.na(rel_change) ~ NA_character_,
      abs(rel_change) < percent_cutoff ~ "—",
      rel_change > 0 ~ "↑",
      TRUE ~ "↓"
    )
  )


general_trend <- slopes_country %>%
  filter(!is.na(sign)) %>%
  count(cause, sign, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(cause) %>%
  mutate(max_n = max(n)) %>%
  filter(n == max_n) %>%
  summarise(
    trend = ifelse(n() > 1, "—", first(sign)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

final_table <- general_trend %>%
  transmute(
    `Νόσημα` = cause,
    `Γενική τάση (1990–2021)` = trend
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Νόσημα`)

kable(final_table, format = "html", align = c("l","c"),
      caption = paste0(
        "Γενική τάση επιπολασμού (Prevalence rate) 1990–2021 ανά νόσημα (↑/↓/—). "
      )) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover"))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

year_start <- 1990
year_end   <- 2021
years_span <- year_end - year_start

stable_cutoff   <- 0.05
mild_cutoff     <- 0.15
moderate_cutoff <- 0.30


df_prev <- full_data %>%
  filter(measure == "Prevalence", metric == "Rate") %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year))


df_age_mean <- df_prev %>%
  group_by(cause, location, sex, year) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


df_country_series <- df_age_mean %>%
  group_by(cause, location, year) %>%
  summarise(val = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


level_tbl <- df_country_series %>%
  group_by(cause, location) %>%
  summarise(level = mean(val, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


slopes_country <- df_country_series %>%
  group_by(cause, location) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(val ~ year, data = .)) %>% filter(term == "year")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(cause, location, slope = estimate) %>%
  left_join(level_tbl, by = c("cause","location")) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_1990_2021 = slope * years_span,
    rel_change = delta_1990_2021 / level,
    annual_pct_change = (slope / level) * 100
  )


general_trend <- slopes_country %>%
  group_by(cause) %>%
  summarise(
    median_rel_change = median(rel_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    annual_pct_change = mean(annual_pct_change, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trend_category = case_when(
      abs(median_rel_change) < stable_cutoff ~ "Σταθερή τάση",
      median_rel_change >= stable_cutoff & median_rel_change < mild_cutoff ~ "Ήπια αύξηση",
      median_rel_change >= mild_cutoff & median_rel_change < moderate_cutoff ~ "Μέτρια αύξηση",
      median_rel_change >= moderate_cutoff ~ "Έντονη αύξηση",
      median_rel_change <= -stable_cutoff & median_rel_change > -mild_cutoff ~ "Ήπια μείωση",
      median_rel_change <= -mild_cutoff & median_rel_change > -moderate_cutoff ~ "Μέτρια μείωση",
      median_rel_change <= -moderate_cutoff ~ "Έντονη μείωση"
    )
  )


final_table <- general_trend %>%
  transmute(
    `Νόσημα` = cause,
    `Κατηγορία τάσης (1990–2021)` = trend_category,
    `Μέση ποσοστιαία αλλαγή ανά έτος (%)` = round(annual_pct_change, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Νόσημα`)


kable(
  final_table,
  format = "html",
  align = c("l","c","c"),
  caption = "Κατηγοριοποίηση της συνολικής τάσης επιπολασμού και μέση ποσοστιαία αλλαγή ανά έτος (1990–2021)."
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","condensed","hover")
  )
```
